rafael-gonzalez-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Rafael González dates from the 1930s and is made under the Cervantes factory name; its box lids carry an English note advising that the cigars be smoked within a month of leaving Havana or else rested for about a year. Filler and binder come from the Vuelta Abajo. Light in strength, the small Perla shows grilled herbs, wood and cream, closing on cocoa, as an aperitif smoke.

thirds.notes: Grilled herbs on the nose and smoky spice on the palate settle into a woody frame with passing creamy sweetness.
Flatter at first, with a faint roasted coffee note, clear wood and the same herbal aroma over a short finish.
A cumin-like spice appears, cream comes and goes, and the close turns rounder with chocolate.
